headline: Off-duty firefighter rescues 3 children trapped under capsized boat
meta_description: An off-duty firefighter sprang into action at Alvarado Lake, rescuing three children who became trapped beneath a capsized boat.
summary_short: Quick thinking and courage saved three young lives when an off-duty firefighter responded to an emergency at Alvarado Lake involving a capsized boat.
body:
An off-duty firefighter rescued three children trapped beneath a capsized boat at Alvarado Lake, demonstrating the kind of split-second heroism that can mean the difference between tragedy and survival.

The firefighter's immediate response and swift action proved crucial in the race against time. With the children pinned under the overturned vessel, every second counted—and the firefighter's training and composure transformed a potentially devastating situation into a story of resilience and community care.

The rescue at Alvarado Lake reminds us that help often comes from those around us, ready to act when danger strikes. The three children's safe return to their families stands as a powerful testament to preparedness and human courage.
